summary: Still Swingin' is a song by the American rock band Papa Roach, released as the first single from their album "The Connection" on June 24, 2012. Fans welcomed the return of the rap-style vocals of the band's early work, and opinions were mixed, though the song was mostly well received. A music video was released on August 30 while lead singer Jacoby Shaddix was recovering from vocal surgery.
one_line: Papa Roach's 2012 rap-style rock single "Still Swingin'", the first release from their album "The Connection".
key_facts: Still Swingin' is a song by the American rock band Papa Roach.
Still Swingin' was released as the first single from the album "The Connection".
Still Swingin' was released on June 24, 2012.
Fans well received the single for the return of the rap-style vocals of Papa Roach's early work.
The track was produced by Tylias, an indie dubstep and hip-hop producer.
Tylias is described as a producer from the underground of the music scene.
Opinions on the song were polarized: some called it new and fresh, while another called it an aberration of the band's style and even of the band.
Overall, the song was mostly well received despite the polarized opinions.
A music video for Still Swingin' was released on August 30.
The music video was released as lead singer Jacoby Shaddix recovered from a vocal surgery.
Jacoby Shaddix is the lead singer of Papa Roach.
